scope: All-video-frame fit with exact-mesh full-hand/FPS512 mean and proximity constraints; local diagnostics, not official scores.

image_review.scope: Every scored frame; identical actual-mesh silhouette metric for control and candidate. Image alignment is a proxy, not official CD-O.

grasp_proximity.scope: Unsigned nearest mesh-vertex proxy on local FPS512 points; not a grasp label.

hand_review.scope: Exact precomputed actual-mesh full-hand/FPS512 evaluations for every frame-option pair, selected without changing geometry. Reused fitting evidence, not an independent hand rerender or official PEN.
